exact_claim: Spherical static-sector theorem: if s>0, b>0, B>0, g>=0 and mu(Y)=bY+R(Y) with |R(Y)| <= K*Y^2 on [0,Y0], then the response equation mu(g/s)*g = B implies g^2 = (s/b)*B + delta with |delta| <= (K/b)*g^3/s, so the deep a0-line constant is a0 = s/b and kappa := a0/s = 1/b; relative correction O(g/s) vanishes in the deep limit. Domain: spherical sector, deep regime B << b*s, explicit remainder hypotheses; theorem is dimensionless and applies identically to both footings (canonical a0=9.3619e-11 m/s^2 and alternative a0=1.1279e-10 m/s^2) once s = a0/kappa is fixed. The theorem does NOT fix b itself: kappa=1/2 follows only with the additional premise b=2 from the separate channel-count programme (PD01/PD08) or SPARC selection (PD01 C2), which this seed does not re-derive.
